title: Rewrite VM architecture to use value stack + activation records
quote: The VM struct is defined in vm.c3 and we can't import it circularly. Instead, use an opaque pointer pattern: Built-in functions receive `void* vm_opaque` (which is really a VM*)
summary: Pivoted from flat register file model to Duktape's value stack + activation record architecture, defining Activation struct and shared valstack model for all frames.
impact: Core VM restructuring affecting how register allocation, function calls, and scope chains work; established the foundation for correct calling conventions and closure support.

title: Scrap current calling convention analysis, reimplement from Duktape design
quote: the disassembly doesnt matter if youre looking at a wrong implementation1!! just reimplement with the right architecture, forget the current code
summary: Rejected analysis-driven bug fixes and demanded greenfield reimplementation of CALL/RET opcodes and register allocation based on real Duktape source, not current broken code.
impact: Stopped iterative bug-fix attempts (Approaches A/B/C) and ordered wholesale redesign of calling convention to match Duktape, ensuring correctness over patch fixes.

title: Analyze QuickJS/Duktape value representation gaps
quote: I need to understand the QuickJS dispatch approach and how Duktape 2.7.0 handles values. Report exact sizes in bytes for each struct and identify the key architectural differences
summary: Request to analyze TVal struct representation vs Duktape's NaN-boxed 8-byte values and compare struct layouts. Establishes baseline understanding of core architectural differences.
impact: Identified that 16-byte TVal vs 8-byte NaN-boxing is a fundamental architectural constraint affecting dispatch performance and recursion depth handling.

title: Acknowledge recursion gap as architectural constraint; defer TVal redesign
quote: The recursion gap is architectural (16-byte TVal vs 8-byte NaN-boxing, no register-binding fast path). Fixing those would require fundamental changes to the value representation and compiler/VM contract — a separate effort.
summary: Recognizes 16-byte TVal and lack of register-binding optimization are architectural constraints. Decides to make plan for fundamental redesign as separate workstream.
impact: Defers architectural overhaul as separate initiative; constrains current optimization efforts to changes within existing TVal system.

title: Extract dispatch loop into reusable function
quote: Extract the dispatch loop: The Vm.execute function (starting at line 1085) has a large dispatch loop (lines 1119-4459). Extract lines 1119-4459 into a new function vm_run_dispatch(Vm* vm, uint stop_count).
summary: Extract main VM dispatch loop (lines 1119-4459) from Vm.execute into new vm_run_dispatch function to enable reuse and independent invocation.
impact: Enables modular dispatch architecture; allows restart logic and continuation-based control flow.

title: Add callee_obj to BuiltinContext
quote: Add `callee_obj` field to BuiltinContext (after `throw_value` field on line 334): callee_obj HObject*; /// The function object being called (for builtins that need to access their own properties).
summary: Add callee_obj HObject* field to BuiltinContext to give builtins access to their own function object for dynamic property manipulation.
impact: Allows Promise callbacks and other builtins to access/update own properties without external state management.

title: Modularize builtins into separate files
quote: We need to split the builtins file into modules I want src/builtins/[name].c3 files. Plan the move carefully to minimize cross dependencies.
summary: Restructure monolithic builtins.c3 into separate module files under src/builtins/.
impact: Major architectural refactoring: enables parallel module development, improves maintainability.

title: Investigate 70-80x shape benchmark gap
quote: In /Users/rtomasi/cousas/duktape-c3, I need to understand why bench_shape_no_call and bench_shape_stress are 70-80x slower than original Duktape
summary: Debug critical perf regression in shape benchmarks (70-80x slower than Duktape).
impact: Course correction: identifies regression requiring root-cause investigation before optimization.

title: Register lifetime in local var compound ops
quote: binary_expr copies left to a temp if its a local variable (to avoid clobbering), but the compound assignment path does NOT
summary: Compound assignment in local variables requires temp register + write-back, not in-place modification
impact: Guides fix for compound assignment corruption: mirror binary_expr pattern with LDREG temp, operate, LDREG result back

title: Verify no duplicate definitions removed
quote: did you remove the duplicated definitions? are they defined somewhere else? double check
summary: Questioned whether duplicate definitions were safely removed; required verification they exist elsewhere.
impact: Prevented silent loss of functionality; enforced verification before cleanup commits.

title: Engine is strict-only; remove all sloppy paths
quote: this is not duktape, its a new project. I want to support strict only and remove all non-strict features. Write a comprehensive plan for this.
summary: Declares the engine will support ES5/ES6 strict mode only; requires comprehensive audit and removal of all sloppy-mode code paths.
impact: Fundamental architecture constraint; eliminates arguments.caller, implicit globals, sloppy eval; greatly simplifies engine model.

title: Conduct code simplification review
quote: now lets look at the code. check the advanced c3 skill. read the sources one by one, and find opportunities to simplify and reduce code size. provide a full report.
summary: Directed systematic code review for simplification opportunities; required comprehensive report on reduction possibilities.
impact: Triggered code quality pass; enabled targeted refactoring to reduce complexity and size.

title: Optimizer bypass validation strategy
quote: can we add a flag to disable the optimizer? then use that to validate the logic without optimizations, re-enable to adjust the optimizer pass for the new features. add notes on this to the docs
summary: Requested feature: disable-optimizer flag to separate logic validation from optimization correctness. Then re-enable to tune optimizer for new features, documenting the approach.
impact: Introduced validation workflow: test logic correctness without optimization, then validate optimizer pass independently. Architecture decision to make optimizer orthogonal to core logic.

title: Iterator protocol for function-param destructuring
quote: Reproduced the bug: function f([a,b]){} called with a generator produces undefined undefined instead of 1 2. Root-caused: the function-param destructuring in functions.c3 uses LDINT index + GETPROP src, index (direct indexed property access) instead of the iterator protocol
summary: Root-cause analysis for B37: function-param destructuring uses direct property access (LDINT+GETPROP) instead of iterator protocol. Catch-clause already uses correct protocol. Three emission sites affected.
impact: Architecture gap identified: function-param destructuring and catch-clause destructuring diverged. Requires unifying on iterator protocol across all three emission sites (regular, inner, arrow functions).

title: Overhaul test harness discipline: 5 concrete improvements
quote: Make fresh-worker batch the canonical verifier...A contamination detector: run each phase with --workers 1 in a fixed order vs. shuffled order...Guard Heap.reset() against drift
summary: Specified 5 concrete harness improvements: (1) batch_test_vm --worker as canonical; (2) contamination-detector script; (3) Heap.reset() struct-diff checker; (4) shrink harness divergence; (5) fresh-process-per-test for final gate.
impact: Replaced ad-hoc testing with reproducible infrastructure; turned flakiness hunting into systematic state-contamination detection; set stage for zero-fail confidence.

title: CLI binaries: duktape_c3 is primary, debug variant for bytecode inspection
quote: I think the naming is wrong. I want duktape_c3 to be the normal way to run a file. duktape_c3_debug or something like that to hav the bytecode compiling/inspect
summary: Rename/restructure CLI: duktape_c3 as main binary; duktape_c3_debug for disasm/inspect mode.
impact: User-facing naming reflects primary workflow; keeps debugging tools available but separate.

title: Proxy constructor: accept lightfunc targets
quote: Fix the Proxy constructor to accept lightfunc (built-in function) values as valid targets.
summary: Extend Proxy validation to allow built-in functions (lightfuncs) as valid Proxy targets, not just HObjects.
impact: Unblocks 5 test262 tests that create proxies wrapping built-in functions like Math.max or Array.isArray.

title: Eval inherits super and new.target from caller
quote: Eval code inside a method should inherit the super binding from the enclosing method. The eval code should be able to use `super.property` to access the parent prototype.
summary: Enable eval to access caller's super binding and new.target. Fix SyntaxError vs TypeError distinctions for super/new.target at different context levels.
impact: Fixes 10+ test262 failures in eval-code tests for super and new.target handling across function and non-function contexts.
